title: Kaithi
desc: An ex-convict's fresh start to life is threatened by vengeful enemies, compelling him to confront the dangers for a chance at freedom.

title: Gajaana
desc: On an adventurous search for treasure in the dense forest, a group of young explorers soon discovers they have become the quarry.

title: Ee Parakkum Thalika
desc: Unni, a bus owner, tries several ways to improve the condition of his bus, which is named after his late father. Things take a turn when the daughter of a powerful politician enters his life.

title: Magic Oven
desc: A renowned chef shares and demonstrates the method to prepare various delicious recipes that can be easily made at home.

title: Shanmukha
desc: A law officer and research scholar investigate an ancient Indian temple's enigmas, tracking scriptures and folklore. Thus, they uncover deity secrets and hidden forest treasure.

title: Ace
desc: Kannan's hope to start a new life abroad is cut short when he gets mixed up with dangerous people. He must outwit fate itself to escape the predicament he is in.

title: Nanban
desc: Two friends set out to find their friend from college, who taught them how to be more than just victims of circumstance. Along the way, they discover previously unknown truths.
